description.narrative: NICOP provides support to the value chain actors in a number of formats and approaches, including training and capacity building but also additional support in relevant themes including coaching, contract farming, branding, marketing linkages, finance and investment facilitation, contract negotiation, innovation introduction, access to cheaper inputs, awareness and sensitization activities, matchmaking, registration, certification, advocacy and alternative dispute resolution.Support in the form of training includes those training events facilitated by and attributable to NICOP using various formats and partners. Value chain actors are: smallholder farmers, MSMEs, cooperatives, clusters, aggregators, offtakers, exporters, retailers, associations, agrodealers, etc. Gendersensitive training approaches are used in order to reach the targeted number of female entrepreneurs.
